data.title: Warner Music Analysts Boost Their Forecasts After Better-Than-Expected Q4 Earnings
data.description: Warner Music beat Q4 estimates with record $2.001B revenue and 55¢ EPS. Analysts raised price targets, while shares dipped 0.5%.

data.title: Potential Sanofi-Insmed Deal: Analysts Split on Financial Strain Versus Pipeline Gains
data.description: Sanofi weighs potential Insmed acquisition to offset Dupixent patent loss, prompting analysts to weigh respiratory synergy against deal cost and capacity.

data.title: These Analysts Slash Their Forecasts On Ross Stores After Q3 Results
data.description: Ross Stores beat Q3 EPS but missed sales, cut Q4 guidance, raised FY2026 outlook; analysts lowered price targets and shares fell 2.6%.

data.title: Cathie Wood Has a Warning for Reddit and Shopify. AI Agents Could Make Their Apps Obsolete
data.description: Cathie Wood warns AI assistants could threaten apps like Reddit and Shopify as consumers shift search and shopping to personal agents.
